assessment.summary: The 15-second vertical (9:16) video consists of a 5-second physical hook scene, a 6-second product demo scene, and a 4-second brand end card CTA. Scene 2 (product demo) and Scene 3 (CTA) align with contract requirements, displaying approved tict UI, brand logo, mascot, onscreen text, and matching voiceovers. However, Scene 1 (hook) omits the required onscreen text headline ('Too much planning?'), extends the sticky note shuffling across the entire 5 seconds without sweeping the paper away or illuminating the phone screen, and shows no facial expression or visible reaction beyond hand movements.

observations.description: Top-down view of hands frantically shuffling color-coded sticky notes across a paper city map on a wooden table, with a dark smartphone resting on the right. Spoken voiceover states: 'You saved fifty spots on the map, but how are you actually spending day one?' accompanied by onscreen voiceover captions at the bottom. The headline text 'Too much planning?' is absent. The paper notes are not swept away, the phone screen remains off, and no face is visible.

Cut to a centered smartphone display showing the approved tict trip overview interface (Dubai itinerary details, stays, flights, activities, total cost, and RESERVE button). Headline text at top reads 'Your whole trip. One plan.' Bottom text and voiceover state: 'tict turns every booking, place, and next step into one clear trip plan.'

Cut to the brand end card featuring the tict logo at top center, yellow location pin mascot (tict-mascot-1) in the center, headline text 'Plan less. Travel more.', and a yellow button CTA reading 'Create your trip' at the bottom. Spoken voiceover and captions state: 'Plan less. Travel more with tict.'
